resources.string: Share a drive, sound card, keyboard or mouse with a PC
Maintain a USB device session, bridge its audio and prepare drive images
Share an image with the PC
Unavailable - Flipper needs its own session
Plug in a USB-C data cable
Waiting for a PC data connection
adb kept on - USB data cable connected
Wheel moves focus - side button selects
The PC opens this as a CD/DVD drive.
Stop returns to USB devices - adb stays on
Choose a folder in Internal storage for your ISO and IMG files. USB devices remembers your choice.
%1$s free on the R1 - chosen image folder
No ISO or IMG images in this folder
ISO becomes a CD drive. IMG becomes a USB stick. Choose an image to review and start.
CDs are read-only. Connect the R1 to the PC with a USB-C data cable.
The PC can edit this image. Eject it on the PC before Stop. Keep it closed on the R1.
%1$s free - keep 1 GB free on the R1
FAT32 - each file must be smaller than 4 GB
exFAT - supports files larger than 4 GB
Creates a blank, writable USB stick image. The PC sees it after creation if you choose Create and use.
Wheel to a size, then click. 1 GB is kept free.
USB starts when the image is ready. Cancelling removes the unfinished image.
Choose an ISO or IMG to copy to your image folder. Wheel selects a location or file.
The original stays where it is. USB devices makes a copy in your chosen folder.
The PC opens this as a CD/DVD drive. adb stays available.
Works while the PC locks the tray
Use Eject on the PC first so pending writes finish. Stop then disconnects the USB drive.
Open Quick Settings, focus the USB devices tile, then click it to stop.
You can leave this screen or lock the R1. Use Stop to end the USB session.
The PC may have locked the tray
You can still replace this read-only disc. The PC may need to refresh the drive.
Drive image - cannot use as a CD
The CD drive stays connected. Your selection replaces only the disc inside it.
The PC may have asked to keep the tray locked. Replacing the disc may interrupt an app reading it.
Only the read-only CD changes. If the PC still shows the old files, refresh or reopen its CD drive.
Click to choose a USB device
Please choose a writable folder in Internal storage. USB sharing needs a local image file, so cloud storage and SD cards cannot be used.
Please choose your image folder again. Its saved access may have changed.
Use a name beginning with a letter or number, up to 87 characters. Use letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens or underscores.
An image with this name already exists. Choose another name.
There is not enough space. Keep at least 1 GB free on the R1.
This image or folder is already mounted or in use. Close it on the R1 and try again.
The image changed. Open the image list again before starting it.
This image has an unsupported size. ISO files need complete CD sectors and must fit on a CD.
Stop the current USB session before changing its image folder or creating another drive.
The PC could not use this USB device. Android has restored its usual USB functions.
USB took too long to respond. Use Stop, then try again.
USB cleanup is still needed. Use Stop to retry before starting another session.
The image could not be formatted. Check the folder and available space, then try again.
The image operation could not finish. Check the image and folder, then try again.
PC sound out - R1 mic in
Type text or control the pointer
Share a drive and control the PC together
Choose R1 USB Audio as the PC output or input. Quick Settings > USB devices also stops it.
Audio is unavailable. Check microphone permission and the PC audio selection, or Stop and retry.
Focus the touchpad: wheel scrolls the PC, side button clicks. Touch moves the pointer; tap clicks. Hold the side button to return to Stop.
Also sharing %1$s - eject on the PC before Stop
Wheel selects a direction. Each side-button click moves the pointer 16 pixels. Touch is optional.
Focus a text box on the PC. English (US) - match the PC layout. Send text sends the draft once, with no Enter. Up to 60 characters.
Input disconnected. Return to the session to retry, or choose Stop.
The text was not sent. Use up to 60 English (US) characters and try again.
This combination needs more USB endpoints than the R1 can provide. Choose fewer devices.
PC sees a keyboard and mouse
PC sees a keyboard and mouse - adb kept on
QS USB devices tile also stops this session
Reverse wheel from Up reaches Stop
Send text sends the draft once - no Enter added
PC sees a sound card - adb kept on
Move a finger to move the PC pointer
Click a left/right action with the side button.\nIn Scroll PC page: wheel scrolls - click to exit.
Focus the target text box on the PC first.\nNothing is sent until you choose Send text.
Wheel moves through keys - side button types.\nUp to 60 English (US) characters.
Use the R1 to type on this PC
